# [pytorch compile] Incorrect result when `compile` changes

<!-- DRAFT generated by tcc. Review every section before filing (plan 18.6). -->

## Summary
The compiled execution is inconsistent with Python eager execution when `compile` changes from `{'dynamic': False}` to `(base)`.
all pre-Inductor layers agree and only Inductor differs: lowering / code generation
This test was generated because the static analysis found: compile flag changes specialization (factor `compile.dynamic`, oracles ['value', 'metadata']).

## Environment
- Python: 3.12.13
- Framework: PyTorch 2.10.0+cu128
- Compiler backend: inductor
- Commit/version: 449b1768410104d3ed79d3bcfe4ba1d65c7f22c0
- CUDA/ROCm: 12.8
- GPU: Tesla T4
- OS: Linux 6.12.90+
- Triton: 3.6.0

## Minimal Reproducer

```python
import torch
torch.manual_seed(0)

def fn(x):
    mask = x == 1
    return mask.max(dim=1, keepdim=True)

args = (torch.randint(0, 4, (2, 8,)),)

eager = fn(*args)
torch._dynamo.reset()
compiled = torch.compile(fn, backend='inductor')(*args)
print('eager   :', eager)
print('compiled:', compiled)
```

## Expected Behavior

Eager/reference result:

```text
structure: P[T,T]
[0] [True, True, True, True, True, True, True, True, ... (248 more)]
[1] [0, 2, 0, 1, 1, 6, 1, 5, ... (248 more)]
```

## Actual Behavior

Compiled result:

```text
structure: P[T,T]
[0] [True, True, True, True, True, True, True, True, ... (248 more)]
[1] [0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, ... (248 more)]
```

## Trigger Condition

Changed semantic factor:

```text
compile: {'dynamic': False} -> (base)
```

Controlled factors:

```text
shape / dtype / stride / device / compile flags: unchanged
```

Execution sequence:

```text
E0_eager: ok
E1_dynamo_eager: ok
E2_aot_eager: ok
E3_inductor: ok
```
